gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans reads crisp and modern, one constant pen width throughout. Baloo Bhaina 2 headings bring bold, wide-set terminals on the s, while pages of body text would flow steadily, c ends pointing apart.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-mulish: Magnified without growing, Baloo Chettan 2 funnels wide channels into every counter. Mulish settles beneath it, approachable, with unmodulated strokes, horseshoe-open apertures and a large x-height under short ascenders.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-rubik: Wide channels leading into each counter make Baloo Chettan 2 look magnified without the size ever changing. The heading grabs attention; Rubik keeps open round letters clear at small sizes.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-instrument-sans: Cap-tall lowercase and wide-set s terminals: that is Baloo Da 2. Instrument Sans follows with a minimal cap-to-lowercase step and a single cutting width, like a laser-cut sheet, so the two sit together without a fight.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-mulish: Baloo Da 2 arrives loud, its lowercase standing almost cap-tall. Mulish then reads smoothly over many lines, one stroke width running through the whole alphabet and apertures open like a horseshoe magnet.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-poppins: Wide-set terminals on the s give bold Baloo Da 2 a smooth, tube-like look, like neon glass. Poppins sits against it, modern and clean, with rope-loose curves and sturdy lowercase.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-rubik: Rubik reads soft and clean, its open round letters staying clear at small sizes. And Baloo Da 2 supplies the shout, with wide-set s terminals and lowercase standing almost cap-tall.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-instrument-sans: A towering lowercase and letters held open rather than curled shut define Baloo Paaji 2. Instrument Sans slips in beside it, plain sans with a minimal cap-to-lowercase step and one stroke weight.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-poppins: Baloo Paaji 2 towers, its lowercase held open, never curled shut. Poppins next to it feels modern and rope-loose, curves never knotting at the ends, sturdy lowercase keeping up.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-rubik: Towering, uncurled lowercase: that is Baloo Paaji 2 in a nutshell. Rubik keeps its soft, clean, big lowercase readable small, though shrink the heading and the commanding presence fades.
